args.summary: Signed on as supervisor super1, looked up member 102777 (Johnson, Katherine), and opened Place Account Hold. Explicitly set Share to [REDACTED:share_id] - Money Market, Reason Code to LEGAL - Legal / levy, and Notes to 'recorded-capability'. Continued to the confirmation screen (Confirmation CN480294), reviewed all three fields, and applied the hold. Read back status: share [REDACTED:share_id] is now HOLD.

reason: the declared success condition 'Share: [REDACTED:share_id] is now HOLD' quotes a value specific to this recording -- the member, amount or identifier that happened to be on screen. It would hold now and fail for every other set of arguments. Success must be stated in terms of what the screen always shows when the goal is met.
